decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting builds on the firm's robust specialist lighting and controls knowledge for demanding transport environments, enabling learning and improvement.

The spring-balanced desk lamp lies outside the firm's core application-specific/industrial lighting expertise and lacks technical complexity, limiting the firm's ability to interpret early results and learn.
The general interior lighting luminaire leverages the firm's existing interior lighting, engineering, and distribution knowledge, so it can readily assimilate feedback.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics draws directly on the firm's optics and interior lighting capabilities, supporting learning and product refinement.
The marine HMI searchlight extends the firm's robust outdoor/specialist lighting know-how into a demanding marine niche, allowing the firm to absorb and apply new information.
The marine searchlight similarly builds on existing high-intensity and robust lighting capabilities, enabling the firm to interpret results and improve the product.
